paragraphs.text:
The next day you see a city on the horizon. Desperately you 
stumble toward it. The domes and minarets suddenly begin to 
tremble and disappear—a mirage! You were foolish to have 
imagined a city in the desert. Drink another day’s water ration 
and choose a direction: for North, go to 255, for East, go to 232; 
for South, go to 279; for West, go to 299. 
(257, 268)
